Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Trainee position at Detergents Europe. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in website management, content creation, and analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your communications plan and support the voice of the cleaning and hygiene products industry in Europe.

In my current role at Episto, I manage WordPress sites, write SEO-optimized content, and track performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. My project mirook.com involved building a site from scratch, implementing structured data, and improving visibility across search engines. I am eager to bring these skills to your team, while also learning from your experienced communications professionals.

I am proactive, organized, and detail-oriented, with a strong willingness to learn. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am prepared to work in Brussels. I am fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Detergents Europe.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Communications Trainee position at Detergents Europe. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content management, I am eager to contribute to your ambitious communications plan and support the association's mission to represent the cleaning and hygiene products industry in Europe.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in website management, content creation, and analytics. I manage client websites on WordPress using Elementor and Astra, write keyword-targeted blog content, and track performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. This experience has honed my ability to coordinate projects, manage timelines, and deliver high-quality digital assets.

My personal project, mirook.com, allowed me to take full ownership of a website build, from design to technical SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my proactive approach, attention to detail, and interest in emerging digital tools and trends.

I am particularly drawn to Detergents Europe because of its dynamic and multicultural environment, and the opportunity to work on impactful projects that support health and sustainability across Europe. I am confident that my skills in digital communications, project coordination, and analytics align well with the responsibilities outlined in the job description.

I am proactive, organized, and able to work independently as well as in a team. I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, making it feasible to work in Brussels. I am excited about the possibility of contributing to your team and growing professionally through this traineeship.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to Detergents Europe.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
